workflowNarrative:
The Pantry Checker runs first, because what is already in the house constrains everything else. It reports what is there rather than what should be there, with the items closest to their date at the top.

The Menu Planner builds the week against that picture, matching effort to the evening, checking who is actually home, planning leftovers on purpose, and leaving one night open because one night always goes wrong. The plan starts with the use-first list rather than with the recipes anyone wanted to cook.

The Shopping List Builder closes the loop, turning the difference between plan and pantry into one list ordered the way the shop is walked, with essentials marked, quantities merged, and a substitute ready for anything likely to be missing. Nothing is ordered and no money is spent.
